{{ config(alias="stg_test_raw_raw_orders") }}

with source_data as (
    select
        "order_id",
        "customer_id",
        "order_status",
        "total_amount",
        "placed_at"
    from {{ source("test_raw", "raw_orders") }}
),
cleaned as (
    select
        -- raw passthroughs with stable names
        s.order_id      as order_id_raw,
        s.customer_id   as customer_id_raw,
        s.order_status  as order_status_raw,
        s.total_amount  as total_amount_raw,
        s.placed_at     as placed_at_raw,

        -- cleaned identifiers
        cast(trim(s.order_id) as varchar)    as order_id,
        cast(trim(s.customer_id) as varchar) as customer_id,

        -- cleaned monetary amount (single total_amount available in schema)
        cast(
            nullif(
                regexp_replace(trim(s.total_amount), '[^0-9\.-]', ''),
                ''
            ) as decimal(18,2)
        ) as total_amount,

        -- cleaned timestamp from string (treated as order_date)
        try_cast(nullif(trim(s.placed_at), '') as timestamp) as order_date,

        -- placeholder timezone source
        'unknown' as timestamp_timezone_source,

        -- normalized order status
        case
            when s.order_status is null then null
            when lower(trim(s.order_status)) in ('pending', 'p') then 'pending'
            when lower(trim(s.order_status)) in ('paid', 'pay') then 'paid'
            when lower(trim(s.order_status)) in ('shipped', 's') then 'shipped'
            when lower(trim(s.order_status)) in ('cancelled', 'c', 'canceled') then 'cancelled'
            when lower(trim(s.order_status)) in ('refunded', 'r') then 'refunded'
            else 'unknown'
        end as order_status,

        -- surrogate key based on available columns (customer_id, order_date, order_id_raw)
        lower(to_hex(
            md5(
                to_utf8(
                    concat_ws(
                        '||',
                        coalesce(cast(trim(s.customer_id) as varchar), ''),
                        coalesce(cast(try_cast(nullif(trim(s.placed_at), '') as timestamp) as varchar), ''),
                        coalesce(cast(s.order_id as varchar), '')
                    )
                )
            )
        )) as order_sk,

        -- FK validity to be populated downstream
        cast(null as boolean) as is_customer_fk_valid,

        -- PK duplication flag (row-preserving) on canonical order_id
        case
            when count(*) over (partition by cast(trim(s.order_id) as varchar)) > 1 then true
            else false
        end as is_pk_duplicated,

        -- mapping quality flag based on raw status
        case
            when s.order_status is null then null
            when lower(trim(s.order_status)) in (
                'pending', 'p',
                'paid', 'pay',
                'shipped', 's',
                'cancelled', 'c', 'canceled',
                'refunded', 'r'
            ) then true
            else false
        end as is_order_status_mapped

    from source_data s
)
select
    -- explicit column list from cleaned CTE (row-preserving)
    order_id_raw,
    customer_id_raw,
    order_status_raw,
    total_amount_raw,
    placed_at_raw,
    order_id,
    customer_id,
    total_amount,
    order_date,
    timestamp_timezone_source,
    order_status,
    order_sk,
    is_customer_fk_valid,
    is_pk_duplicated,
    is_order_status_mapped
from cleaned

{{ config(alias="stg_test_raw_raw_order_items") }}

with base as (
    select
        order_item_id,
        order_id,
        product_sku,
        quantity,
        unit_price
    from {{ source("test_raw", "raw_order_items") }}
), cleaned as (
    select
        -- raw passthrough (will be exposed with _raw suffix in final select)
        order_item_id,
        order_id,
        product_sku,
        quantity,
        unit_price,

        -- cleaned string ids
        trim(order_item_id) as order_item_id_clean,
        trim(order_id)      as order_id_clean,
        trim(product_sku)   as product_sku_clean,

        -- cleaned numeric strings (strip non-numeric chars except sign and dot)
        nullif(regexp_replace(trim(quantity),   '[^0-9\\.-]', ''), '')   as quantity_num_str,
        nullif(regexp_replace(trim(unit_price), '[^0-9\\.-]', ''), '')   as unit_price_num_str
    from base
), typed as (
    select
        order_item_id,
        order_id,
        product_sku,
        quantity,
        unit_price,
        order_item_id_clean,
        order_id_clean,
        product_sku_clean,
        quantity_num_str,
        unit_price_num_str,
        try_cast(quantity_num_str   as decimal(18,6)) as quantity_dec,
        try_cast(unit_price_num_str as decimal(18,6)) as unit_price_dec
    from cleaned
)
select
    -- raw/source columns (renamed with _raw suffix to avoid duplicate output names)
    order_item_id  as order_item_id_raw,
    order_id       as order_id_raw,
    product_sku    as product_sku_raw,
    quantity       as quantity_raw,
    unit_price     as unit_price_raw,

    -- cleaned / canonical fields
    cast(order_item_id_clean as varchar) as order_item_id,
    cast(order_id_clean      as varchar) as order_id,
    cast(product_sku_clean   as varchar) as product_sku_clean,

    -- quantity: coerce invalid/negative to null per plan
    case
        when quantity_dec >= cast(0 as decimal(18,6)) then quantity_dec
        else null
    end as quantity,

    -- unit_price: keep any successfully cast value (including negative), quality flag will handle sign
    unit_price_dec as unit_price,

    -- surrogate key using available identifiers
    md5(
        to_utf8(
            coalesce(cast(order_id_clean       as varchar), '') || '||' ||
            coalesce(cast(order_item_id_clean as varchar), '')
        )
    ) as order_item_sk,

    -- quality / validation flags
    cast(null as boolean) as is_order_fk_valid,

    case
        when quantity_dec is null then null
        when quantity_dec >= cast(0 as decimal(18,6)) then true
        else false
    end as is_quantity_valid,

    case
        when unit_price_dec is null then null
        when unit_price_dec >= cast(0 as decimal(18,6)) then true
        else false
    end as is_unit_price_valid,

    case
        when count(*) over (
            partition by coalesce(cast(order_item_id_clean as varchar), cast(order_id_clean as varchar))
        ) > 1 then true
        else false
    end as is_pk_duplicated
from typed

with source_data as (
    select
        "order_id",
        "customer_id",
        "order_status",
        "total_amount",
        "placed_at"
    from {{ source("test_raw", "raw_orders") }}
),
cleaned as (
    select
        -- raw passthroughs with stable names
        s.order_id      as order_id_raw,
        s.customer_id   as customer_id_raw,
        s.order_status  as order_status_raw,
        s.total_amount  as total_amount_raw,
        s.placed_at     as placed_at_raw,

        -- cleaned identifiers
        cast(trim(s.order_id) as varchar)    as order_id,
        cast(trim(s.customer_id) as varchar) as customer_id,

        -- cleaned monetary amount (single total_amount available in schema)
        cast(
            nullif(
                regexp_replace(trim(s.total_amount), '[^0-9\.-]', ''),
                ''
            ) as decimal(18,2)
        ) as total_amount,

        -- cleaned timestamp from string (treated as order_date)
        try_cast(nullif(trim(s.placed_at), '') as timestamp) as order_date,

        -- placeholder timezone source
        'unknown' as timestamp_timezone_source,

        -- normalized order status
        case
            when s.order_status is null then null
            when lower(trim(s.order_status)) in ('pending', 'p') then 'pending'
            when lower(trim(s.order_status)) in ('paid', 'pay') then 'paid'
            when lower(trim(s.order_status)) in ('shipped', 's') then 'shipped'
            when lower(trim(s.order_status)) in ('cancelled', 'c', 'canceled') then 'cancelled'
            when lower(trim(s.order_status)) in ('refunded', 'r') then 'refunded'
            else 'unknown'
        end as order_status,

        -- surrogate key based on available columns (customer_id, order_date, order_id_raw)
        lower(to_hex(
            md5(
                to_utf8(
                    concat_ws(
                        '||',
                        coalesce(cast(trim(s.customer_id) as varchar), ''),
                        coalesce(cast(try_cast(nullif(trim(s.placed_at), '') as timestamp) as varchar), ''),
                        coalesce(cast(s.order_id as varchar), '')
                    )
                )
            )
        )) as order_sk,

        -- FK validity to be populated downstream
        cast(null as boolean) as is_customer_fk_valid,

        -- PK duplication flag (row-preserving) on canonical order_id
        case
            when count(*) over (partition by cast(trim(s.order_id) as varchar)) > 1 then true
            else false
        end as is_pk_duplicated,

        -- mapping quality flag based on raw status
        case
            when s.order_status is null then null
            when lower(trim(s.order_status)) in (
                'pending', 'p',
                'paid', 'pay',
                'shipped', 's',
                'cancelled', 'c', 'canceled',
                'refunded', 'r'
            ) then true
            else false
        end as is_order_status_mapped

    from source_data s
)
select
    -- explicit column list from cleaned CTE (row-preserving)
    order_id_raw,
    customer_id_raw,
    order_status_raw,
    total_amount_raw,
    placed_at_raw,
    order_id,
    customer_id,
    total_amount,
    order_date,
    timestamp_timezone_source,
    order_status,
    order_sk,
    is_customer_fk_valid,
    is_pk_duplicated,
    is_order_status_mapped
from cleaned

with base as (
    select
        order_item_id,
        order_id,
        product_sku,
        quantity,
        unit_price
    from {{ source("test_raw", "raw_order_items") }}
), cleaned as (
    select
        -- raw passthrough (will be exposed with _raw suffix in final select)
        order_item_id,
        order_id,
        product_sku,
        quantity,
        unit_price,

        -- cleaned string ids
        trim(order_item_id) as order_item_id_clean,
        trim(order_id)      as order_id_clean,
        trim(product_sku)   as product_sku_clean,

        -- cleaned numeric strings (strip non-numeric chars except sign and dot)
        nullif(regexp_replace(trim(quantity),   '[^0-9\\.-]', ''), '')   as quantity_num_str,
        nullif(regexp_replace(trim(unit_price), '[^0-9\\.-]', ''), '')   as unit_price_num_str
    from base
), typed as (
    select
        order_item_id,
        order_id,
        product_sku,
        quantity,
        unit_price,
        order_item_id_clean,
        order_id_clean,
        product_sku_clean,
        quantity_num_str,
        unit_price_num_str,
        try_cast(quantity_num_str   as decimal(18,6)) as quantity_dec,
        try_cast(unit_price_num_str as decimal(18,6)) as unit_price_dec
    from cleaned
)
select
    -- raw/source columns (renamed with _raw suffix to avoid duplicate output names)
    order_item_id  as order_item_id_raw,
    order_id       as order_id_raw,
    product_sku    as product_sku_raw,
    quantity       as quantity_raw,
    unit_price     as unit_price_raw,

    -- cleaned / canonical fields
    cast(order_item_id_clean as varchar) as order_item_id,
    cast(order_id_clean      as varchar) as order_id,
    cast(product_sku_clean   as varchar) as product_sku_clean,

    -- quantity: coerce invalid/negative to null per plan
    case
        when quantity_dec >= cast(0 as decimal(18,6)) then quantity_dec
        else null
    end as quantity,

    -- unit_price: keep any successfully cast value (including negative), quality flag will handle sign
    unit_price_dec as unit_price,

    -- surrogate key using available identifiers
    md5(
        to_utf8(
            coalesce(cast(order_id_clean       as varchar), '') || '||' ||
            coalesce(cast(order_item_id_clean as varchar), '')
        )
    ) as order_item_sk,

    -- quality / validation flags
    cast(null as boolean) as is_order_fk_valid,

    case
        when quantity_dec is null then null
        when quantity_dec >= cast(0 as decimal(18,6)) then true
        else false
    end as is_quantity_valid,

    case
        when unit_price_dec is null then null
        when unit_price_dec >= cast(0 as decimal(18,6)) then true
        else false
    end as is_unit_price_valid,

    case
        when count(*) over (
            partition by coalesce(cast(order_item_id_clean as varchar), cast(order_id_clean as varchar))
        ) > 1 then true
        else false
    end as is_pk_duplicated
from typed

    select
        "order_id",
        "customer_id",
        "order_status",

        "placed_at"
    from {{ source("test_raw", "raw_orders") }}
),

        s.order_id      as order_id_raw,
        s.customer_id   as customer_id_raw,
        s.order_status  as order_status_raw,
        s.total_amount  as total_amount_raw,
        s.placed_at     as placed_at_raw,

        -- cleaned identifiers
        cast(trim(s.order_id) as varchar)    as order_id,
        cast(trim(s.customer_id) as varchar) as customer_id,

        -- cleaned monetary amount (single total_amount available in schema)
        cast(
            nullif(
                regexp_replace(trim(s.total_amount), '[^0-9\.-]', ''),
                ''
            ) as decimal(18,2)
        ) as total_amount,

        -- cleaned timestamp from string (treated as order_date)
        try_cast(nullif(trim(s.placed_at), '') as timestamp) as order_date,

        -- placeholder timezone source
        'unknown' as timestamp_timezone_source,

        -- normalized order status
        case
            when s.order_status is null then null
            when lower(trim(s.order_status)) in ('pending', 'p') then 'pending'
            when lower(trim(s.order_status)) in ('paid', 'pay') then 'paid'
            when lower(trim(s.order_status)) in ('shipped', 's') then 'shipped'
            when lower(trim(s.order_status)) in ('cancelled', 'c', 'canceled') then 'cancelled'
            when lower(trim(s.order_status)) in ('refunded', 'r') then 'refunded'

    is_order_status_mapped
from cleaned

with base as (
    select
        customer_id,
        email,
        first_name,
        last_name,
        created_at
    from {{ source("test_raw", "raw_customers") }}
),
clean as (
    select
        -- raw passthrough columns
        customer_id,
        email,
        first_name,
        last_name,
        created_at,

        -- explicit raw aliases
        customer_id as customer_id_raw,
        email as email_raw,
        first_name as first_name_raw,
        last_name as last_name_raw,
        created_at as created_at_raw,

        -- trimmed / canonical text fields
        cast(trim(customer_id) as varchar) as customer_id_clean,
        lower(trim(email)) as email_lc_trimmed,
        trim(first_name) as first_name_clean,
        trim(last_name) as last_name_clean,

        -- created_at parsed from string -> timestamp (row-preserving via try_cast)
        try_cast(nullif(trim(created_at), '') as timestamp) as created_at_ts
    from base
),
final as (
    select
        -- raw-style columns
        customer_id_raw,
        email_raw,
        first_name_raw,
        last_name_raw,
        created_at_raw,

        -- cleaned canonical columns
        customer_id_clean as customer_id,
        case
            when regexp_like(email_lc_trimmed, '^[^\\s@]+@[^\\s@]+\\.[^\\s@]+$') then email_lc_trimmed
            else null
        end as email,
        first_name_clean as first_name,
        last_name_clean as last_name,
        created_at_ts as created_at,
        cast('unknown' as varchar) as timestamp_timezone_source,

        -- email quality flag: true if normalized email is valid; null when raw missing
        case
            when email_raw is null then null
            when regexp_like(email_lc_trimmed, '^[^\\s@]+@[^\\s@]+\\.[^\\s@]+$') then true
            else false
        end as is_email_valid,

        -- surrogate customer key (hash) using available attributes
        to_hex(
            md5(
                cast(
                    concat_ws(
                        '||',
                        coalesce(
                            case
                                when regexp_like(email_lc_trimmed, '^[^\\s@]+@[^\\s@]+\\.[^\\s@]+$') then email_lc_trimmed
                                else null
                            end,
                            ''
                        ),
                        coalesce(first_name_clean, ''),
                        coalesce(last_name_clean, ''),
                        coalesce(cast(created_at_ts as varchar), '')
                    )
                    as varbinary
                )
            )
        ) as customer_sk,

with base as (
    select
        order_item_id,
        order_id,
        product_sku,
        quantity,
        unit_price
    from {{ source("test_raw", "raw_order_items") }}
), cleaned as (
    select
        -- raw passthrough (will be exposed with _raw suffix in final select)
        order_item_id,
        order_id,
        product_sku,
        quantity,
        unit_price,

        -- cleaned string ids
        trim(order_item_id) as order_item_id_clean,
        trim(order_id)      as order_id_clean,
        trim(product_sku)   as product_sku_clean,

        -- cleaned numeric strings (strip non-numeric chars except sign and dot)
        nullif(regexp_replace(trim(quantity),   '[^0-9\\.-]', ''), '')   as quantity_num_str,
        nullif(regexp_replace(trim(unit_price), '[^0-9\\.-]', ''), '')   as unit_price_num_str
    from base
), typed as (
    select
        order_item_id,
        order_id,
        product_sku,
        quantity,
        unit_price,
        order_item_id_clean,
        order_id_clean,
        product_sku_clean,
        quantity_num_str,
        unit_price_num_str,
        try_cast(quantity_num_str   as decimal(18,6)) as quantity_dec,
        try_cast(unit_price_num_str as decimal(18,6)) as unit_price_dec
    from cleaned
)
select
    -- raw/source columns (renamed with _raw suffix to avoid duplicate output names)
    order_item_id  as order_item_id_raw,
    order_id       as order_id_raw,
    product_sku    as product_sku_raw,
    quantity       as quantity_raw,
    unit_price     as unit_price_raw,

    -- cleaned / canonical fields
    cast(order_item_id_clean as varchar) as order_item_id,
    cast(order_id_clean      as varchar) as order_id,
    cast(product_sku_clean   as varchar) as product_sku_clean,

    -- quantity: coerce invalid/negative to null per plan
    case
        when quantity_dec >= cast(0 as decimal(18,6)) then quantity_dec
        else null
    end as quantity,

    -- unit_price: keep any successfully cast value (including negative), quality flag will handle sign
    unit_price_dec as unit_price,

    -- surrogate key using available identifiers
    md5(
        to_utf8(
            coalesce(cast(order_id_clean       as varchar), '') || '||' ||
            coalesce(cast(order_item_id_clean as varchar), '')
        )
    ) as order_item_sk,

    -- quality / validation flags
    cast(null as boolean) as is_order_fk_valid,

    case
        when quantity_dec is null then null
        when quantity_dec >= cast(0 as decimal(18,6)) then true
        else false
    end as is_quantity_valid,

    case
        when unit_price_dec is null then null
        when unit_price_dec >= cast(0 as decimal(18,6)) then true
        else false
    end as is_unit_price_valid,

    case
        when count(*) over (
            partition by coalesce(cast(order_item_id_clean as varchar), cast(order_id_clean as varchar))
        ) > 1 then true
        else false
    end as is_pk_duplicated
from typed

{{ config(alias="stg_test_raw_raw_orders") }}

with source_data as (
    select
        "order_id",
        "customer_id",
        "order_status",
        "total_amount",
        "placed_at"
    from {{ source("test_raw", "raw_orders") }}
),
cleaned as (
    select
        -- raw passthroughs with stable names
        s.order_id      as order_id_raw,
        s.customer_id   as customer_id_raw,
        s.order_status  as order_status_raw,
        s.total_amount  as total_amount_raw,
        s.placed_at     as placed_at_raw,

        -- cleaned identifiers
        cast(trim(s.order_id) as varchar)    as order_id,
        cast(trim(s.customer_id) as varchar) as customer_id,

        -- cleaned monetary amount (single total_amount available in schema)
        cast(
            nullif(
                regexp_replace(trim(s.total_amount), '[^0-9\.-]', ''),
                ''
            ) as decimal(18,2)
        ) as total_amount,

        -- cleaned timestamp from string (treated as order_date)
        try_cast(nullif(trim(s.placed_at), '') as timestamp) as order_date,

        -- placeholder timezone source
        'unknown' as timestamp_timezone_source,

        -- normalized order status
        case
            when s.order_status is null then null
            when lower(trim(s.order_status)) in ('pending', 'p') then 'pending'
            when lower(trim(s.order_status)) in ('paid', 'pay') then 'paid'
            when lower(trim(s.order_status)) in ('shipped', 's') then 'shipped'
            when lower(trim(s.order_status)) in ('cancelled', 'c', 'canceled') then 'cancelled'
            when lower(trim(s.order_status)) in ('refunded', 'r') then 'refunded'
            else 'unknown'
        end as order_status,

        -- surrogate key based on available columns (customer_id, order_date, order_id_raw)
        lower(to_hex(
            md5(
                to_utf8(
                    concat_ws(
                        '||',
                        coalesce(cast(trim(s.customer_id) as varchar), ''),
                        coalesce(cast(try_cast(nullif(trim(s.placed_at), '') as timestamp) as varchar), ''),
                        coalesce(cast(s.order_id as varchar), '')
                    )
                )
            )
        )) as order_sk,

        -- FK validity to be populated downstream
        cast(null as boolean) as is_customer_fk_valid,

        -- PK duplication flag (row-preserving) on canonical order_id
        case
            when count(*) over (partition by cast(trim(s.order_id) as varchar)) > 1 then true
            else false
        end as is_pk_duplicated,

        -- mapping quality flag based on raw status
        case
            when s.order_status is null then null
            when lower(trim(s.order_status)) in (
                'pending', 'p',
                'paid', 'pay',
                'shipped', 's',
                'cancelled', 'c', 'canceled',
                'refunded', 'r'
            ) then true
            else false
        end as is_order_status_mapped

    from source_data s
)
select
    -- explicit column list from cleaned CTE (row-preserving)
    order_id_raw,
    customer_id_raw,
    order_status_raw,
    total_amount_raw,
    placed_at_raw,
    order_id,
    customer_id,
    total_amount,
    order_date,
    timestamp_timezone_source,
    order_status,
    order_sk,
    is_customer_fk_valid,
    is_pk_duplicated,
    is_order_status_mapped
from cleaned

with base as (
    select
        customer_id,
        email,
        first_name,
        last_name,
        created_at
    from {{ source("test_raw", "raw_customers") }}
),
clean as (
    select
        -- raw passthrough columns
        customer_id,
        email,
        first_name,
        last_name,
        created_at,

        -- explicit raw aliases
        customer_id as customer_id_raw,
        email as email_raw,
        first_name as first_name_raw,
        last_name as last_name_raw,
        created_at as created_at_raw,

        -- trimmed / canonical text fields
        cast(trim(customer_id) as varchar) as customer_id_clean,
        lower(trim(email)) as email_lc_trimmed,
        trim(first_name) as first_name_clean,
        trim(last_name) as last_name_clean,

        -- created_at parsed from string -> timestamp (row-preserving via try_cast)
        try_cast(nullif(trim(created_at), '') as timestamp) as created_at_ts
    from base
),
final as (
    select
        -- raw-style columns
        customer_id_raw,
        email_raw,
        first_name_raw,
        last_name_raw,
        created_at_raw,

        -- cleaned canonical columns
        customer_id_clean as customer_id,
        case
            when regexp_like(email_lc_trimmed, '^[^\\s@]+@[^\\s@]+\\.[^\\s@]+$') then email_lc_trimmed
            else null
        end as email,
        first_name_clean as first_name,
        last_name_clean as last_name,
        created_at_ts as created_at,
        cast('unknown' as varchar) as timestamp_timezone_source,

        -- email quality flag: true if normalized email is valid; null when raw missing
        case
            when email_raw is null then null
            when regexp_like(email_lc_trimmed, '^[^\\s@]+@[^\\s@]+\\.[^\\s@]+$') then true
            else false
        end as is_email_valid,

        -- surrogate customer key (hash) using available attributes
        to_hex(
            md5(
                cast(
                    concat_ws(
                        '||',
                        coalesce(
                            case
                                when regexp_like(email_lc_trimmed, '^[^\\s@]+@[^\\s@]+\\.[^\\s@]+$') then email_lc_trimmed
                                else null
                            end,
                            ''
                        ),
                        coalesce(first_name_clean, ''),
                        coalesce(last_name_clean, ''),
                        coalesce(cast(created_at_ts as varchar), '')
                    )
                    as varbinary
                )
            )
        ) as customer_sk,

        -- primary-key duplication flag over cleaned customer_id
        case
            when count(*) over (partition by customer_id_clean) > 1 then true
            else false
        end as is_pk_duplicated
    from clean
)
select
    customer_id_raw,
    email_raw,
    first_name_raw,
    last_name_raw,
    created_at_raw,
    customer_id,
    email,
    first_name,
    last_name,
    created_at,
    timestamp_timezone_source,
    is_email_valid,
    customer_sk,
    is_pk_duplicated
from final;

with source_data as (
    select
        "order_id",
        "customer_id",
        "order_status",
        "total_amount",
        "placed_at"
    from {{ source("test_raw", "raw_orders") }}
),
cleaned as (
    select
        -- raw passthroughs with stable names
        s.order_id      as order_id_raw,
        s.customer_id   as customer_id_raw,
        s.order_status  as order_status_raw,
        s.total_amount  as total_amount_raw,
        s.placed_at     as placed_at_raw,

        -- cleaned identifiers
        cast(trim(s.order_id) as varchar)    as order_id,
        cast(trim(s.customer_id) as varchar) as customer_id,

        -- cleaned monetary amount (single total_amount available in schema)
        cast(
            nullif(
                regexp_replace(trim(s.total_amount), '[^0-9\.-]', ''),
                ''
            ) as decimal(18,2)
        ) as total_amount,

        -- cleaned timestamp from string (treated as order_date)
        try_cast(nullif(trim(s.placed_at), '') as timestamp) as order_date,

        -- placeholder timezone source
        'unknown' as timestamp_timezone_source,

        -- normalized order status
        case
            when s.order_status is null then null
            when lower(trim(s.order_status)) in ('pending', 'p') then 'pending'
            when lower(trim(s.order_status)) in ('paid', 'pay') then 'paid'
            when lower(trim(s.order_status)) in ('shipped', 's') then 'shipped'
            when lower(trim(s.order_status)) in ('cancelled', 'c', 'canceled') then 'cancelled'
            when lower(trim(s.order_status)) in ('refunded', 'r') then 'refunded'
            else 'unknown'
        end as order_status,

        -- surrogate key based on available columns (customer_id, order_date, order_id_raw)
        lower(to_hex(
            md5(
                to_utf8(
                    concat_ws(
                        '||',
                        coalesce(cast(trim(s.customer_id) as varchar), ''),
                        coalesce(cast(try_cast(nullif(trim(s.placed_at), '') as timestamp) as varchar), ''),
                        coalesce(cast(s.order_id as varchar), '')
                    )
                )
            )
        )) as order_sk,

        -- FK validity to be populated downstream
        cast(null as boolean) as is_customer_fk_valid,

        -- PK duplication flag (row-preserving) on canonical order_id
        case
            when count(*) over (partition by cast(trim(s.order_id) as varchar)) > 1 then true
            else false
        end as is_pk_duplicated,

        -- mapping quality flag based on raw status
        case
            when s.order_status is null then null
            when lower(trim(s.order_status)) in (
                'pending', 'p',
                'paid', 'pay',
                'shipped', 's',
                'cancelled', 'c', 'canceled',
                'refunded', 'r'
            ) then true
            else false
        end as is_order_status_mapped

    from source_data s
)
select
    -- explicit column list from cleaned CTE (row-preserving)
    order_id_raw,
    customer_id_raw,
    order_status_raw,
    total_amount_raw,
    placed_at_raw,
    order_id,
    customer_id,
    total_amount,
    order_date,
    timestamp_timezone_source,
    order_status,
    order_sk,
    is_customer_fk_valid,
    is_pk_duplicated,
    is_order_status_mapped
from cleaned

with base as (
    select
        order_item_id,
        order_id,
        product_sku,
        quantity,
        unit_price
    from {{ source("test_raw", "raw_order_items") }}
), cleaned as (
    select
        -- raw passthrough (will be exposed with _raw suffix in final select)
        order_item_id,
        order_id,
        product_sku,
        quantity,
        unit_price,

        -- cleaned string ids
        trim(order_item_id) as order_item_id_clean,
        trim(order_id)      as order_id_clean,
        trim(product_sku)   as product_sku_clean,

{{ config(alias="stg_test_raw_raw_customers") }}

with base as (
    select
        customer_id,
        email,
        first_name,
        last_name,
        created_at
    from {{ source("test_raw", "raw_customers") }}
),
clean as (
    select
        -- raw passthrough columns
        customer_id,
        email,
        first_name,
        last_name,
        created_at,

        -- explicit raw aliases
        customer_id as customer_id_raw,
        email as email_raw,
        first_name as first_name_raw,
        last_name as last_name_raw,
        created_at as created_at_raw,

        -- trimmed / canonical text fields
        cast(trim(customer_id) as varchar) as customer_id_clean,
        lower(trim(email)) as email_lc_trimmed,
        trim(first_name) as first_name_clean,
        trim(last_name) as last_name_clean,

        -- created_at parsed from string -> timestamp (row-preserving via try_cast)
        try_cast(nullif(trim(created_at), '') as timestamp) as created_at_ts
    from base
),
final as (
    select
        -- raw-style columns
        customer_id_raw,
        email_raw,
        first_name_raw,
        last_name_raw,
        created_at_raw,

        -- cleaned canonical columns
        customer_id_clean as customer_id,
        case
            when regexp_like(email_lc_trimmed, '^[^\\s@]+@[^\\s@]+\\.[^\\s@]+$') then email_lc_trimmed
            else null
        end as email,
        first_name_clean as first_name,
        last_name_clean as last_name,
        created_at_ts as created_at,
        cast('unknown' as varchar) as timestamp_timezone_source,

        -- email quality flag: true if normalized email is valid; null when raw missing
        case
            when email_raw is null then null
            when regexp_like(email_lc_trimmed, '^[^\\s@]+@[^\\s@]+\\.[^\\s@]+$') then true
            else false
        end as is_email_valid,

        -- surrogate customer key (hash) using available attributes
        to_hex(
            md5(
                cast(
                    concat_ws(
                        '||',
                        coalesce(
                            case
                                when regexp_like(email_lc_trimmed, '^[^\\s@]+@[^\\s@]+\\.[^\\s@]+$') then email_lc_trimmed
                                else null
                            end,
                            ''
                        ),
                        coalesce(first_name_clean, ''),
                        coalesce(last_name_clean, ''),
                        coalesce(cast(created_at_ts as varchar), '')
                    )
                    as varbinary
                )
            )
        ) as customer_sk,

        -- primary-key duplication flag over cleaned customer_id
        case
            when count(*) over (partition by customer_id_clean) > 1 then true
            else false
        end as is_pk_duplicated
    from clean
)
select
    customer_id_raw,
    email_raw,
    first_name_raw,
    last_name_raw,
    created_at_raw,
    customer_id,
    email,
    first_name,
    last_name,
    created_at,
    timestamp_timezone_source,
    is_email_valid,
    customer_sk,
    is_pk_duplicated
from final;

with source_data as (
    select
        "order_id",
        "customer_id",
        "order_status",
        "total_amount",
        "placed_at"
    from {{ source("test_raw", "raw_orders") }}
),
cleaned as (
    select
        -- raw passthroughs with stable names
        s.order_id      as order_id_raw,
        s.customer_id   as customer_id_raw,
        s.order_status  as order_status_raw,
        s.total_amount  as total_amount_raw,
        s.placed_at     as placed_at_raw,

        -- cleaned identifiers
        cast(trim(s.order_id) as varchar)    as order_id,
        cast(trim(s.customer_id) as varchar) as customer_id,

        -- cleaned monetary amount (single total_amount available in schema)
        cast(
            nullif(
                regexp_replace(trim(s.total_amount), '[^0-9\.-]', ''),
                ''
            ) as decimal(18,2)
        ) as total_amount,

        -- cleaned timestamp from string (treated as order_date)
        try_cast(nullif(trim(s.placed_at), '') as timestamp) as order_date,

        -- placeholder timezone source
        'unknown' as timestamp_timezone_source,

        -- normalized order status
        case
            when s.order_status is null then null
            when lower(trim(s.order_status)) in ('pending', 'p') then 'pending'
            when lower(trim(s.order_status)) in ('paid', 'pay') then 'paid'
            when lower(trim(s.order_status)) in ('shipped', 's') then 'shipped'
            when lower(trim(s.order_status)) in ('cancelled', 'c', 'canceled') then 'cancelled'
            when lower(trim(s.order_status)) in ('refunded', 'r') then 'refunded'
            else 'unknown'
        end as order_status,

        -- surrogate key based on available columns (customer_id, order_date, order_id_raw)
        lower(to_hex(
            md5(
                to_utf8(
                    concat_ws(
                        '||',
                        coalesce(cast(trim(s.customer_id) as varchar), ''),
                        coalesce(cast(try_cast(nullif(trim(s.placed_at), '') as timestamp) as varchar), ''),
                        coalesce(cast(s.order_id as varchar), '')
                    )
                )
            )
        )) as order_sk,

        -- FK validity to be populated downstream
        cast(null as boolean) as is_customer_fk_valid,

        -- PK duplication flag (row-preserving) on canonical order_id
        case
            when count(*) over (partition by cast(trim(s.order_id) as varchar)) > 1 then true
            else false
        end as is_pk_duplicated,

        -- mapping quality flag based on raw status
        case
            when s.order_status is null then null
            when lower(trim(s.order_status)) in (
                'pending', 'p',
                'paid', 'pay',
                'shipped', 's',
                'cancelled', 'c', 'canceled',
                'refunded', 'r'
            ) then true
            else false
        end as is_order_status_mapped

    from source_data s
)
select
    -- explicit column list from cleaned CTE (row-preserving)
    order_id_raw,
    customer_id_raw,
    order_status_raw,
    total_amount_raw,
    placed_at_raw,
    order_id,
    customer_id,
    total_amount,
    order_date,
    timestamp_timezone_source,
    order_status,
    order_sk,
    is_customer_fk_valid,
    is_pk_duplicated,
    is_order_status_mapped
from cleaned

{{ config(alias="stg_test_raw_raw_order_items") }}

with base as (
    select
        order_item_id,
        order_id,
        product_sku,
        quantity,
        unit_price
    from {{ source("test_raw", "raw_order_items") }}
), cleaned as (
    select
        -- raw passthrough (will be exposed with _raw suffix in final select)
        order_item_id,
        order_id,
        product_sku,
        quantity,
        unit_price,

        -- cleaned string ids
        trim(order_item_id) as order_item_id_clean,
        trim(order_id)      as order_id_clean,
        trim(product_sku)   as product_sku_clean,

        -- cleaned numeric strings (strip non-numeric chars except sign and dot)
        nullif(regexp_replace(trim(quantity),   '[^0-9\\.-]', ''), '')   as quantity_num_str,
        nullif(regexp_replace(trim(unit_price), '[^0-9\\.-]', ''), '')   as unit_price_num_str
    from base
), typed as (
    select
        order_item_id,
        order_id,
        product_sku,
        quantity,
        unit_price,
        order_item_id_clean,
        order_id_clean,
        product_sku_clean,
        quantity_num_str,
        unit_price_num_str,
        try_cast(quantity_num_str   as decimal(18,6)) as quantity_dec,
        try_cast(unit_price_num_str as decimal(18,6)) as unit_price_dec
    from cleaned
)
select
    -- raw/source columns (renamed with _raw suffix to avoid duplicate output names)
    order_item_id  as order_item_id_raw,
    order_id       as order_id_raw,
    product_sku    as product_sku_raw,
    quantity       as quantity_raw,
    unit_price     as unit_price_raw,

    -- cleaned / canonical fields
    cast(order_item_id_clean as varchar) as order_item_id,
    cast(order_id_clean      as varchar) as order_id,
    cast(product_sku_clean   as varchar) as product_sku_clean,

    -- quantity: coerce invalid/negative to null per plan
    case
        when quantity_dec >= cast(0 as decimal(18,6)) then quantity_dec
        else null
    end as quantity,

    -- unit_price: keep any successfully cast value (including negative), quality flag will handle sign
    unit_price_dec as unit_price,

    -- surrogate key using available identifiers
    md5(
        to_utf8(
            coalesce(cast(order_id_clean       as varchar), '') || '||' ||
            coalesce(cast(order_item_id_clean as varchar), '')
        )
    ) as order_item_sk,

    -- quality / validation flags
    cast(null as boolean) as is_order_fk_valid,

    case
        when quantity_dec is null then null
        when quantity_dec >= cast(0 as decimal(18,6)) then true
        else false
    end as is_quantity_valid,

    case
        when unit_price_dec is null then null
        when unit_price_dec >= cast(0 as decimal(18,6)) then true
        else false
    end as is_unit_price_valid,

    case
        when count(*) over (
            partition by coalesce(cast(order_item_id_clean as varchar), cast(order_id_clean as varchar))
        ) > 1 then true
        else false
    end as is_pk_duplicated
from typed

{{ config(alias="stg_test_raw_raw_customers") }}

with base as (
    select
        customer_id,
        email,
        first_name,
        last_name,
        created_at
    from {{ source("test_raw", "raw_customers") }}
),
clean as (
    select
        -- raw passthrough columns
        customer_id,
        email,
        first_name,
        last_name,
        created_at,

        -- explicit raw aliases
        customer_id as customer_id_raw,
        email as email_raw,
        first_name as first_name_raw,
        last_name as last_name_raw,
        created_at as created_at_raw,

        -- trimmed / canonical text fields
        cast(trim(customer_id) as varchar) as customer_id_clean,
        lower(trim(email)) as email_lc_trimmed,
        trim(first_name) as first_name_clean,
        trim(last_name) as last_name_clean,

        -- created_at parsed from string -> timestamp (row-preserving via try_cast)
        try_cast(nullif(trim(created_at), '') as timestamp) as created_at_ts
    from base
),
final as (
    select
        -- raw-style columns
        customer_id_raw,
        email_raw,
        first_name_raw,
        last_name_raw,
        created_at_raw,

        -- cleaned canonical columns
        customer_id_clean as customer_id,
        case
            when regexp_like(email_lc_trimmed, '^[^\\s@]+@[^\\s@]+\\.[^\\s@]+$') then email_lc_trimmed
            else null
        end as email,
        first_name_clean as first_name,
        last_name_clean as last_name,
        created_at_ts as created_at,
        cast('unknown' as varchar) as timestamp_timezone_source,

        -- email quality flag: true if normalized email is valid; null when raw missing
        case
            when email_raw is null then null
            when regexp_like(email_lc_trimmed, '^[^\\s@]+@[^\\s@]+\\.[^\\s@]+$') then true
            else false
        end as is_email_valid,

        -- surrogate customer key (hash) using available attributes
        to_hex(
            md5(
                cast(
                    concat_ws(
                        '||',
                        coalesce(
                            case
                                when regexp_like(email_lc_trimmed, '^[^\\s@]+@[^\\s@]+\\.[^\\s@]+$') then email_lc_trimmed
                                else null
                            end,
                            ''
                        ),
                        coalesce(first_name_clean, ''),
                        coalesce(last_name_clean, ''),
                        coalesce(cast(created_at_ts as varchar), '')
                    )
                    as varbinary
                )
            )
        ) as customer_sk,

        -- primary-key duplication flag over cleaned customer_id
        case
            when count(*) over (partition by customer_id_clean) > 1 then true
            else false
        end as is_pk_duplicated
    from clean
)
select
    customer_id_raw,
    email_raw,
    first_name_raw,
    last_name_raw,
    created_at_raw,
    customer_id,
    email,
    first_name,
    last_name,
    created_at,
    timestamp_timezone_source,
    is_email_valid,
    customer_sk,
    is_pk_duplicated
from final;

with base as (
    select
        customer_id,
        email,
        first_name,
        last_name,
        created_at
    from {{ source("test_raw", "raw_customers") }}
),
clean as (
    select
        -- raw passthrough columns
        customer_id,
        email,
        first_name,
        last_name,
        created_at,

        -- explicit raw aliases
        customer_id as customer_id_raw,
        email as email_raw,
        first_name as first_name_raw,
        last_name as last_name_raw,
        created_at as created_at_raw,

        -- trimmed / canonical text fields
        cast(trim(customer_id) as varchar) as customer_id_clean,
        lower(trim(email)) as email_lc_trimmed,
        trim(first_name) as first_name_clean,
        trim(last_name) as last_name_clean,

        -- created_at parsed from string -> timestamp (row-preserving via try_cast)
        try_cast(nullif(trim(created_at), '') as timestamp) as created_at_ts
    from base
),
final as (
    select
        -- raw-style columns
        customer_id_raw,
        email_raw,
        first_name_raw,
        last_name_raw,
        created_at_raw,

        -- cleaned canonical columns
        customer_id_clean as customer_id,
        case
            when regexp_like(email_lc_trimmed, '^[^\\s@]+@[^\\s@]+\\.[^\\s@]+$') then email_lc_trimmed
            else null
        end as email,
        first_name_clean as first_name,
        last_name_clean as last_name,
        created_at_ts as created_at,
        cast('unknown' as varchar) as timestamp_timezone_source,

        -- email quality flag: true if normalized email is valid; null when raw missing
        case
            when email_raw is null then null
            when regexp_like(email_lc_trimmed, '^[^\\s@]+@[^\\s@]+\\.[^\\s@]+$') then true
            else false
        end as is_email_valid,

        -- surrogate customer key (hash) using available attributes
        to_hex(
            md5(
                cast(
                    concat_ws(
                        '||',
                        coalesce(
                            case
                                when regexp_like(email_lc_trimmed, '^[^\\s@]+@[^\\s@]+\\.[^\\s@]+$') then email_lc_trimmed
                                else null
                            end,
                            ''
                        ),
                        coalesce(first_name_clean, ''),
                        coalesce(last_name_clean, ''),
                        coalesce(cast(created_at_ts as varchar), '')
                    )
                    as varbinary
                )
            )
        ) as customer_sk,

        -- primary-key duplication flag over cleaned customer_id
        case
            when count(*) over (partition by customer_id_clean) > 1 then true
            else false
        end as is_pk_duplicated
    from clean
)
select
    customer_id_raw,
    email_raw,
    first_name_raw,
    last_name_raw,
    created_at_raw,
    customer_id,
    email,
    first_name,
    last_name,
    created_at,
    timestamp_timezone_source,
    is_email_valid,
    customer_sk,
    is_pk_duplicated
from final;

{{ config(alias="stg_test_raw_raw_customers") }}

with base as (
    select
        customer_id,
        email,
        first_name,
        last_name,
        created_at
    from {{ source("test_raw", "raw_customers") }}
),
clean as (
    select
        -- raw passthrough columns
        customer_id,
        email,
        first_name,
        last_name,
        created_at,

        -- explicit raw aliases
        customer_id as customer_id_raw,
        email as email_raw,
        first_name as first_name_raw,
        last_name as last_name_raw,
        created_at as created_at_raw,

        -- trimmed / canonical text fields
        cast(trim(customer_id) as varchar) as customer_id_clean,
        lower(trim(email)) as email_lc_trimmed,
        trim(first_name) as first_name_clean,
        trim(last_name) as last_name_clean,

        -- created_at parsed from string -> timestamp (row-preserving via try_cast)
        try_cast(nullif(trim(created_at), '') as timestamp) as created_at_ts
    from base
),
final as (
    select
        -- raw-style columns
        customer_id_raw,
        email_raw,
        first_name_raw,
        last_name_raw,
        created_at_raw,

        -- cleaned canonical columns
        customer_id_clean as customer_id,
        case
            when regexp_like(email_lc_trimmed, '^[^\\s@]+@[^\\s@]+\\.[^\\s@]+$') then email_lc_trimmed
            else null
        end as email,
        first_name_clean as first_name,
        last_name_clean as last_name,
        created_at_ts as created_at,
        cast('unknown' as varchar) as timestamp_timezone_source,

        -- email quality flag: true if normalized email is valid; null when raw missing
        case
            when email_raw is null then null
            when regexp_like(email_lc_trimmed, '^[^\\s@]+@[^\\s@]+\\.[^\\s@]+$') then true
            else false
        end as is_email_valid,

        -- surrogate customer key (hash) using available attributes
        to_hex(
            md5(
                cast(
                    concat_ws(
                        '||',
                        coalesce(
                            case
                                when regexp_like(email_lc_trimmed, '^[^\\s@]+@[^\\s@]+\\.[^\\s@]+$') then email_lc_trimmed
                                else null
                            end,
                            ''
                        ),
                        coalesce(first_name_clean, ''),
                        coalesce(last_name_clean, ''),
                        coalesce(cast(created_at_ts as varchar), '')
                    )
                    as varbinary
                )
            )
        ) as customer_sk,

        -- primary-key duplication flag over cleaned customer_id
        case
            when count(*) over (partition by customer_id_clean) > 1 then true
            else false
        end as is_pk_duplicated
    from clean
)
select
    customer_id_raw,
    email_raw,
    first_name_raw,
    last_name_raw,
    created_at_raw,
    customer_id,
    email,
    first_name,
    last_name,
    created_at,
    timestamp_timezone_source,
    is_email_valid,
    customer_sk,
    is_pk_duplicated
from final;

{{ config(alias="stg_test_raw_raw_orders") }}

with source_data as (
    select
        "order_id",
        "customer_id",
        "order_status",
        "total_amount",
        "placed_at"
    from {{ source("test_raw", "raw_orders") }}
),
cleaned as (
    select
        -- raw passthroughs with stable names
        s.order_id      as order_id_raw,
        s.customer_id   as customer_id_raw,
        s.order_status  as order_status_raw,
        s.total_amount  as total_amount_raw,
        s.placed_at     as placed_at_raw,

        -- cleaned identifiers
        cast(trim(s.order_id) as varchar)    as order_id,
        cast(trim(s.customer_id) as varchar) as customer_id,

        -- cleaned monetary amount (single total_amount available in schema)
        cast(
            nullif(
                regexp_replace(trim(s.total_amount), '[^0-9\.-]', ''),
                ''
            ) as decimal(18,2)
        ) as total_amount,

        -- cleaned timestamp from string (treated as order_date)
        try_cast(nullif(trim(s.placed_at), '') as timestamp) as order_date,

        -- placeholder timezone source
        'unknown' as timestamp_timezone_source,

        -- normalized order status
        case
            when s.order_status is null then null
            when lower(trim(s.order_status)) in ('pending', 'p') then 'pending'
            when lower(trim(s.order_status)) in ('paid', 'pay') then 'paid'
            when lower(trim(s.order_status)) in ('shipped', 's') then 'shipped'
            when lower(trim(s.order_status)) in ('cancelled', 'c', 'canceled') then 'cancelled'
            when lower(trim(s.order_status)) in ('refunded', 'r') then 'refunded'
            else 'unknown'
        end as order_status,

        -- surrogate key based on available columns (customer_id, order_date, order_id_raw)
        lower(to_hex(
            md5(
                to_utf8(
                    concat_ws(
                        '||',
                        coalesce(cast(trim(s.customer_id) as varchar), ''),
                        coalesce(cast(try_cast(nullif(trim(s.placed_at), '') as timestamp) as varchar), ''),
                        coalesce(cast(s.order_id as varchar), '')
                    )
                )
            )
        )) as order_sk,

        -- FK validity to be populated downstream
        cast(null as boolean) as is_customer_fk_valid,

        -- PK duplication flag (row-preserving) on canonical order_id
        case
            when count(*) over (partition by cast(trim(s.order_id) as varchar)) > 1 then true
            else false
        end as is_pk_duplicated,

        -- mapping quality flag based on raw status
        case
            when s.order_status is null then null
            when lower(trim(s.order_status)) in (
                'pending', 'p',
                'paid', 'pay',
                'shipped', 's',
                'cancelled', 'c', 'canceled',
                'refunded', 'r'
            ) then true
            else false
        end as is_order_status_mapped

    from source_data s
)
select
    -- explicit column list from cleaned CTE (row-preserving)
    order_id_raw,
    customer_id_raw,
    order_status_raw,
    total_amount_raw,
    placed_at_raw,
    order_id,
    customer_id,
    total_amount,
    order_date,
    timestamp_timezone_source,
    order_status,
    order_sk,
    is_customer_fk_valid,
    is_pk_duplicated,
    is_order_status_mapped
from cleaned

observation.content:
{{ config(alias="stg_test_raw_raw_customers") }}

with base as (
    select
        customer_id,
        email,
        first_name,
        last_name,
        created_at
    from {{ source("test_raw", "raw_customers") }}
),
clean as (
    select
        -- raw passthrough columns
        customer_id,
        email,
        first_name,
        last_name,
        created_at,

        -- explicit raw aliases
        customer_id as customer_id_raw,
        email as email_raw,
        first_name as first_name_raw,
        last_name as last_name_raw,
        created_at as created_at_raw,

        -- trimmed / canonical text fields
        cast(trim(customer_id) as varchar) as customer_id_clean,
        lower(trim(email)) as email_lc_trimmed,
        trim(first_name) as first_name_clean,
        trim(last_name) as last_name_clean,

        -- created_at parsed from string -> timestamp (row-preserving via try_cast)
        try_cast(nullif(trim(created_at), '') as timestamp) as created_at_ts
    from base
),
final as (
    select
        -- raw-style columns
        customer_id_raw,
        email_raw,
        first_name_raw,
        last_name_raw,
        created_at_raw,

        -- cleaned canonical columns
        customer_id_clean as customer_id,
        case
            when regexp_like(email_lc_trimmed, '^[^\\s@]+@[^\\s@]+\\.[^\\s@]+$') then email_lc_trimmed
            else null
        end as email,
        first_name_clean as first_name,
        last_name_clean as last_name,
        created_at_ts as created_at,
        cast('unknown' as varchar) as timestamp_timezone_source,

        -- email quality flag: true if normalized email is valid; null when raw missing
        case
            when email_raw is null then null
            when regexp_like(email_lc_trimmed, '^[^\\s@]+@[^\\s@]+\\.[^\\s@]+$') then true
            else false
        end as is_email_valid,

        -- surrogate customer key (hash) using available attributes
        to_hex(
            md5(
                cast(
                    concat_ws(
                        '||',
                        coalesce(
                            case
                                when regexp_like(email_lc_trimmed, '^[^\\s@]+@[^\\s@]+\\.[^\\s@]+$') then email_lc_trimmed
                                else null
                            end,
                            ''
                        ),
                        coalesce(first_name_clean, ''),
                        coalesce(last_name_clean, ''),
                        coalesce(cast(created_at_ts as varchar), '')
                    )
                    as varbinary
                )
            )
        ) as customer_sk,

        -- primary-key duplication flag over cleaned customer_id
        case
            when count(*) over (partition by customer_id_clean) > 1 then true
            else false
        end as is_pk_duplicated
    from clean
)
select
    customer_id_raw,
    email_raw,
    first_name_raw,
    last_name_raw,
    created_at_raw,
    customer_id,
    email,
    first_name,
    last_name,
    created_at,
    timestamp_timezone_source,
    is_email_valid,
    customer_sk,
    is_pk_duplicated
from final;

with base as (
    select
        order_item_id,
        order_id,
        product_sku,
        quantity,
        unit_price
    from {{ source("test_raw", "raw_order_items") }}
), cleaned as (
    select
        -- raw passthrough (will be exposed with _raw suffix in final select)
        order_item_id,
        order_id,
        product_sku,
        quantity,
        unit_price,

        -- cleaned string ids
        trim(order_item_id) as order_item_id_clean,
        trim(order_id)      as order_id_clean,
        trim(product_sku)   as product_sku_clean,

        -- cleaned numeric strings (strip non-numeric chars except sign and dot)
        nullif(regexp_replace(trim(quantity),   '[^0-9\\.-]', ''), '')   as quantity_num_str,
        nullif(regexp_replace(trim(unit_price), '[^0-9\\.-]', ''), '')   as unit_price_num_str
    from base
), typed as (
    select
        order_item_id,
        order_id,
        product_sku,
        quantity,
        unit_price,
        order_item_id_clean,
        order_id_clean,
        product_sku_clean,
        quantity_num_str,
        unit_price_num_str,
        try_cast(quantity_num_str   as decimal(18,6)) as quantity_dec,
        try_cast(unit_price_num_str as decimal(18,6)) as unit_price_dec
    from cleaned
)
select
    -- raw/source columns (renamed with _raw suffix to avoid duplicate output names)
    order_item_id  as order_item_id_raw,
    order_id       as order_id_raw,
    product_sku    as product_sku_raw,
    quantity       as quantity_raw,
    unit_price     as unit_price_raw,

    -- cleaned / canonical fields
    cast(order_item_id_clean as varchar) as order_item_id,
    cast(order_id_clean      as varchar) as order_id,
    cast(product_sku_clean   as varchar) as product_sku_clean,

    -- quantity: coerce invalid/negative to null per plan
    case
        when quantity_dec >= cast(0 as decimal(18,6)) then quantity_dec
        else null
    end as quantity,

    -- unit_price: keep any successfully cast value (including negative), quality flag will handle sign
    unit_price_dec as unit_price,

    -- surrogate key using available identifiers
    md5(
        to_utf8(
            coalesce(cast(order_id_clean       as varchar), '') || '||' ||
            coalesce(cast(order_item_id_clean as varchar), '')
        )
    ) as order_item_sk,

    -- quality / validation flags
    cast(null as boolean) as is_order_fk_valid,

    case
        when quantity_dec is null then null
        when quantity_dec >= cast(0 as decimal(18,6)) then true
        else false
    end as is_quantity_valid,

    case
        when unit_price_dec is null then null
        when unit_price_dec >= cast(0 as decimal(18,6)) then true
        else false
    end as is_unit_price_valid,

    case
        when count(*) over (
            partition by coalesce(cast(order_item_id_clean as varchar), cast(order_id_clean as varchar))
        ) > 1 then true
        else false
    end as is_pk_duplicated
from typed

        'unknown' as timestamp_timezone_source,

        case
            when s.order_status is null then null
            when lower(trim(s.order_status)) in ('pending', 'p') then 'pending'
            when lower(trim(s.order_status)) in ('paid', 'pay') then 'paid'
            when lower(trim(s.order_status)) in ('shipped', 's') then 'shipped'
            when lower(trim(s.order_status)) in ('cancelled', 'c', 'canceled') then 'cancelled'

{{ config(alias="stg_test_raw_raw_customers") }}

with base as (
    select
        customer_id,
        email,
        first_name,
        last_name,
        created_at
    from {{ source("test_raw", "raw_customers") }}
),
clean as (
    select
        -- raw passthrough columns
        customer_id,
        email,
        first_name,
        last_name,
        created_at,

        -- explicit raw aliases
        customer_id as customer_id_raw,
        email as email_raw,
        first_name as first_name_raw,
        last_name as last_name_raw,
        created_at as created_at_raw,

        -- trimmed / canonical text fields
        cast(trim(customer_id) as varchar) as customer_id_clean,
        lower(trim(email)) as email_lc_trimmed,
        trim(first_name) as first_name_clean,
        trim(last_name) as last_name_clean,

        -- created_at parsed from string -> timestamp (row-preserving via try_cast)
        try_cast(nullif(trim(created_at), '') as timestamp) as created_at_ts
    from base
),
final as (
    select
        -- raw-style columns
        customer_id_raw,
        email_raw,
        first_name_raw,
        last_name_raw,
        created_at_raw,

        -- cleaned canonical columns
        customer_id_clean as customer_id,
        case
            when regexp_like(email_lc_trimmed, '^[^\\s@]+@[^\\s@]+\\.[^\\s@]+$') then email_lc_trimmed
            else null
        end as email,
        first_name_clean as first_name,
        last_name_clean as last_name,
        created_at_ts as created_at,
        cast('unknown' as varchar) as timestamp_timezone_source,

        -- email quality flag: true if normalized email is valid; null when raw missing
        case
            when email_raw is null then null
            when regexp_like(email_lc_trimmed, '^[^\\s@]+@[^\\s@]+\\.[^\\s@]+$') then true
            else false
        end as is_email_valid,

        -- surrogate customer key (hash) using available attributes
        to_hex(
            md5(
                cast(
                    concat_ws(
                        '||',
                        coalesce(
                            case
                                when regexp_like(email_lc_trimmed, '^[^\\s@]+@[^\\s@]+\\.[^\\s@]+$') then email_lc_trimmed
                                else null
                            end,
                            ''
                        ),

with base as (
    select
        order_item_id,
        order_id,
        product_sku,
        quantity,
        unit_price
    from {{ source("test_raw", "raw_order_items") }}
), cleaned as (
    select
        -- raw passthrough (will be exposed with _raw suffix in final select)
        order_item_id,
        order_id,
        product_sku,
        quantity,
        unit_price,

        -- cleaned string ids
        trim(order_item_id) as order_item_id_clean,
        trim(order_id)      as order_id_clean,
        trim(product_sku)   as product_sku_clean,

        -- cleaned numeric strings (strip non-numeric chars except sign and dot)
        nullif(regexp_replace(trim(quantity),   '[^0-9\\.-]', ''), '')   as quantity_num_str,
        nullif(regexp_replace(trim(unit_price), '[^0-9\\.-]', ''), '')   as unit_price_num_str
    from base
), typed as (
    select
        order_item_id,
        order_id,
        product_sku,
        quantity,
        unit_price,
        order_item_id_clean,
        order_id_clean,
        product_sku_clean,
        quantity_num_str,
        unit_price_num_str,
        try_cast(quantity_num_str   as decimal(18,6)) as quantity_dec,
        try_cast(unit_price_num_str as decimal(18,6)) as unit_price_dec
    from cleaned
)
select
    -- raw/source columns (renamed with _raw suffix to avoid duplicate output names)
    order_item_id  as order_item_id_raw,
    order_id       as order_id_raw,
    product_sku    as product_sku_raw,
    quantity       as quantity_raw,
    unit_price     as unit_price_raw,

    -- cleaned / canonical fields
    cast(order_item_id_clean as varchar) as order_item_id,
    cast(order_id_clean      as varchar) as order_id,
    cast(product_sku_clean   as varchar) as product_sku_clean,

    -- quantity: coerce invalid/negative to null per plan
    case
        when quantity_dec >= cast(0 as decimal(18,6)) then quantity_dec
        else null
    end as quantity,

    -- unit_price: keep any successfully cast value (including negative), quality flag will handle sign
    unit_price_dec as unit_price,

    -- surrogate key using available identifiers
    md5(
        to_utf8(
            coalesce(cast(order_id_clean       as varchar), '') || '||' ||
            coalesce(cast(order_item_id_clean as varchar), '')
        )
    ) as order_item_sk,

    -- quality / validation flags
    cast(null as boolean) as is_order_fk_valid,

    case
        when quantity_dec is null then null
        when quantity_dec >= cast(0 as decimal(18,6)) then true
        else false
    end as is_quantity_valid,

    case
        when unit_price_dec is null then null
        when unit_price_dec >= cast(0 as decimal(18,6)) then true
        else false
    end as is_unit_price_valid,

    case
        when count(*) over (
            partition by coalesce(cast(order_item_id_clean as varchar), cast(order_id_clean as varchar))
        ) > 1 then true
        else false
    end as is_pk_duplicated
from typed

    select

        "customer_id",

        "total_amount",
        "placed_at"
    from {{ source("test_raw", "raw_orders") }}
),
cleaned as (
    select

        s.order_id      as order_id_raw,
        s.customer_id   as customer_id_raw,
        s.order_status  as order_status_raw,
        s.total_amount  as total_amount_raw,
        s.placed_at     as placed_at_raw,

        -- cleaned identifiers
        cast(trim(s.order_id) as varchar)    as order_id,
        cast(trim(s.customer_id) as varchar) as customer_id,

        -- cleaned monetary amount (single total_amount available in schema)
        cast(
            nullif(
                regexp_replace(trim(s.total_amount), '[^0-9\.-]', ''),
                ''
            ) as decimal(18,2)
        ) as total_amount,

        -- cleaned timestamp from string (treated as order_date)
        try_cast(nullif(trim(s.placed_at), '') as timestamp) as order_date,

        -- placeholder timezone source
        'unknown' as timestamp_timezone_source,

        -- normalized order status
        case
            when s.order_status is null then null
            when lower(trim(s.order_status)) in ('pending', 'p') then 'pending'
            when lower(trim(s.order_status)) in ('paid', 'pay') then 'paid'
            when lower(trim(s.order_status)) in ('shipped', 's') then 'shipped'
            when lower(trim(s.order_status)) in ('cancelled', 'c', 'canceled') then 'cancelled'
            when lower(trim(s.order_status)) in ('refunded', 'r') then 'refunded'
            else 'unknown'
        end as order_status,

        -- surrogate key based on available columns (customer_id, order_date, order_id_raw)
        lower(to_hex(
            md5(
                to_utf8(
                    concat_ws(
                        '||',
                        coalesce(cast(trim(s.customer_id) as varchar), ''),
                        coalesce(cast(try_cast(nullif(trim(s.placed_at), '') as timestamp) as varchar), ''),
                        coalesce(cast(s.order_id as varchar), '')
                    )
                )
            )
        )) as order_sk,

        -- FK validity to be populated downstream
        cast(null as boolean) as is_customer_fk_valid,

        -- PK duplication flag (row-preserving) on canonical order_id
        case
            when count(*) over (partition by cast(trim(s.order_id) as varchar)) > 1 then true
            else false
        end as is_pk_duplicated,

        -- mapping quality flag based on raw status
        case
            when s.order_status is null then null
            when lower(trim(s.order_status)) in (
                'pending', 'p',
                'paid', 'pay',
                'shipped', 's',
                'cancelled', 'c', 'canceled',
                'refunded', 'r'

            else false
        end as is_order_status_mapped

    -- explicit column list from cleaned CTE (row-preserving)

    order_id,
    customer_id,
    total_amount,
    order_date,
    timestamp_timezone_source,
    order_status,
    order_sk,
    is_customer_fk_valid,
    is_pk_duplicated,
    is_order_status_mapped
from cleaned

with base as (
    select
        order_item_id,
        order_id,
        product_sku,
        quantity,
        unit_price
    from {{ source("test_raw", "raw_order_items") }}
), cleaned as (
    select
        -- raw passthrough (will be exposed with _raw suffix in final select)
        order_item_id,
        order_id,
        product_sku,
        quantity,
        unit_price,

        -- cleaned string ids
        trim(order_item_id) as order_item_id_clean,
        trim(order_id)      as order_id_clean,
        trim(product_sku)   as product_sku_clean,

        -- cleaned numeric strings (strip non-numeric chars except sign and dot)
        nullif(regexp_replace(trim(quantity),   '[^0-9\\.-]', ''), '')   as quantity_num_str,
        nullif(regexp_replace(trim(unit_price), '[^0-9\\.-]', ''), '')   as unit_price_num_str
    from base
), typed as (
    select
        order_item_id,
        order_id,
        product_sku,
        quantity,
        unit_price,
        order_item_id_clean,
        order_id_clean,
        product_sku_clean,
        quantity_num_str,
        unit_price_num_str,
        try_cast(quantity_num_str   as decimal(18,6)) as quantity_dec,
        try_cast(unit_price_num_str as decimal(18,6)) as unit_price_dec
    from cleaned
)
select
    -- raw/source columns (renamed with _raw suffix to avoid duplicate output names)
    order_item_id  as order_item_id_raw,
    order_id       as order_id_raw,
    product_sku    as product_sku_raw,
    quantity       as quantity_raw,
    unit_price     as unit_price_raw,

    -- cleaned / canonical fields
    cast(order_item_id_clean as varchar) as order_item_id,
    cast(order_id_clean      as varchar) as order_id,
    cast(product_sku_clean   as varchar) as product_sku_clean,

    -- quantity: coerce invalid/negative to null per plan
    case
        when quantity_dec >= cast(0 as decimal(18,6)) then quantity_dec
        else null
    end as quantity,

    -- unit_price: keep any successfully cast value (including negative), quality flag will handle sign
    unit_price_dec as unit_price,

    -- surrogate key using available identifiers
    md5(
        to_utf8(
            coalesce(cast(order_id_clean       as varchar), '') || '||' ||
            coalesce(cast(order_item_id_clean as varchar), '')
        )
    ) as order_item_sk,

    -- quality / validation flags
    cast(null as boolean) as is_order_fk_valid,

    case
        when quantity_dec is null then null
        when quantity_dec >= cast(0 as decimal(18,6)) then true
        else false
    end as is_quantity_valid,

    case
        when unit_price_dec is null then null
        when unit_price_dec >= cast(0 as decimal(18,6)) then true
        else false
    end as is_unit_price_valid,

    case
        when count(*) over (
            partition by coalesce(cast(order_item_id_clean as varchar), cast(order_id_clean as varchar))
        ) > 1 then true
        else false
    end as is_pk_duplicated
from typed

version: 2
models:
- name: stg_test_raw_raw_orders
  description: Silver staging model for raw orders from AwsDataCatalog.test_raw.raw_orders. Standardizes keys, status, timestamps, and amounts for downstream consumption.
  config:
    materialized: incremental
    tags:
    - silver
    - orders
    - staging
    contract:
      enforced: false
  columns:
  - name: order_sk
    description: Surrogate key for the order record used as the primary key in the warehouse.
    tests:
    - not_null
    - unique
  - name: order_id
    description: Business order identifier after cleansing and standardization from the raw source.
  - name: order_id_raw
    description: Original unmodified order identifier as stored in the raw source.
  - name: customer_id
    description: Cleansed customer identifier associated with the order, aligned to the customer dimension key where possible.
  - name: customer_id_raw
    description: Original customer identifier value from the raw orders dataset prior to any standardization.
  - name: order_status
    description: Mapped and standardized order status used consistently across the warehouse.
  - name: order_status_raw
    description: Original order status value as received from the raw orders source system.
  - name: is_order_status_mapped
    description: Flag indicating whether the raw order status was successfully mapped to a standardized status code (true) or not (false).
  - name: order_date
    description: Canonical order date derived from the raw placed-at timestamp, used for date-based analysis and partitioning.
  - name: placed_at_raw
    description: Raw placed-at timestamp value as stored in the source, prior to timezone normalization and cleansing.
  - name: timestamp_timezone_source
    description: Label or code describing the timezone or timezone-assumption used when interpreting the raw order timestamps.
  - name: total_amount
    description: Cleaned numeric total order amount used for financial reporting and aggregations.
  - name: total_amount_raw
    description: Original total amount value from the raw orders dataset before any type casting, rounding, or currency normalization.
  - name: is_customer_fk_valid
    description: Flag indicating whether the associated customer_id successfully links to a known customer record (true) or is invalid/unmatched (false).
  - name: is_pk_duplicated
    description: Flag set when multiple raw records share the same business order identifier, indicating a potential primary key duplication issue.

with base as (
    select
        customer_id,
        email,
        first_name,
        last_name,
        created_at
    from {{ source("test_raw", "raw_customers") }}
),
clean as (
    select
        -- raw passthrough columns
        customer_id,
        email,
        first_name,
        last_name,
        created_at,

        -- explicit raw aliases
        customer_id as customer_id_raw,
        email as email_raw,
        first_name as first_name_raw,
        last_name as last_name_raw,
        created_at as created_at_raw,

        -- trimmed / canonical text fields
        cast(trim(customer_id) as varchar) as customer_id_clean,
        lower(trim(email)) as email_lc_trimmed,
        trim(first_name) as first_name_clean,
        trim(last_name) as last_name_clean,

        -- created_at parsed from string -> timestamp (row-preserving via try_cast)
        try_cast(nullif(trim(created_at), '') as timestamp) as created_at_ts
    from base
),
final as (
    select
        -- raw-style columns
        customer_id_raw,
        email_raw,
        first_name_raw,
        last_name_raw,
        created_at_raw,

        -- cleaned canonical columns
        customer_id_clean as customer_id,
        case
            when regexp_like(email_lc_trimmed, '^[^\\s@]+@[^\\s@]+\\.[^\\s@]+$') then email_lc_trimmed
            else null
        end as email,
        first_name_clean as first_name,
        last_name_clean as last_name,

        case
            when email_raw is null then null
            when regexp_like(email_lc_trimmed, '^[^\\s@]+@[^\\s@]+\\.[^\\s@]+$') then true
            else false
        end as is_email_valid,

        -- surrogate customer key (hash) using available attributes
        to_hex(
            md5(
                cast(
                    concat_ws(
                        '||',
                        coalesce(
                            case

        -- primary-key duplication flag over cleaned customer_id
        case

)

    first_name_raw,
    last_name_raw,
    created_at_raw,
    customer_id,
    email,

    last_name,
    created_at,

    is_email_valid,
    customer_sk,
    is_pk_duplicated

with source_data as (
    select
        "order_id",
        "customer_id",
        "order_status",
        "total_amount",
        "placed_at"
    from {{ source("test_raw", "raw_orders") }}
),
cleaned as (
    select
        -- raw passthroughs with stable names
        s.order_id      as order_id_raw,
        s.customer_id   as customer_id_raw,
        s.order_status  as order_status_raw,
        s.total_amount  as total_amount_raw,
        s.placed_at     as placed_at_raw,

        -- cleaned identifiers
        cast(trim(s.order_id) as varchar)    as order_id,
        cast(trim(s.customer_id) as varchar) as customer_id,

        -- cleaned monetary amount (single total_amount available in schema)
        cast(
            nullif(
                regexp_replace(trim(s.total_amount), '[^0-9\.-]', ''),
                ''
            ) as decimal(18,2)
        ) as total_amount,

        -- cleaned timestamp from string (treated as order_date)
        try_cast(nullif(trim(s.placed_at), '') as timestamp) as order_date,

        -- placeholder timezone source
        'unknown' as timestamp_timezone_source,

        -- normalized order status
        case
            when s.order_status is null then null
            when lower(trim(s.order_status)) in ('pending', 'p') then 'pending'
            when lower(trim(s.order_status)) in ('paid', 'pay') then 'paid'
            when lower(trim(s.order_status)) in ('shipped', 's') then 'shipped'
            when lower(trim(s.order_status)) in ('cancelled', 'c', 'canceled') then 'cancelled'
            when lower(trim(s.order_status)) in ('refunded', 'r') then 'refunded'
            else 'unknown'
